css-border-radius-generator.name: CSS Border Radius Generator
css-border-radius-generator.description: Design rounded corners and elliptical shapes locally with independent corner radii, live preview and copyable CSS.

meta.title: CSS Border Radius Generator
meta.description: Design rounded corners and elliptical shapes locally with independent corner radii, live preview and copyable CSS.
meta.keywords: CSS border radius generator, rounded corners, elliptical radii, blob, border-radius, px, percent

borderRadius.hint: Enter radii from 0–1000 px or 0–100%, with up to two decimal places. Corners follow physical clockwise order, even in right-to-left layouts.
borderRadius.previewHint: Preview: up to 320 × 180 CSS pixels; width shrinks on small screens. Only the border-radius declaration is exported.
borderRadius.emptyResult: Enter valid radii to see the preview and CSS.
borderRadius.rules: Horizontal percentages refer to width; vertical percentages refer to height. The browser scales overlapping radii proportionally. Changing units keeps the numbers without converting them. CSS import is not supported.
borderRadius.invalidRadius: {corner} · {axis}: enter a number from 0 to {limit}, with up to two decimal places.
borderRadius.cornerCount: Provide exactly four radii per axis.
